claim_text: The Minnesota Attorney General's office told KSTP it separately tracks roughly $61 million in civil judgments/settlements (as distinct from the $32 million in MFCU criminal restitution ordered since 2019); as of the 2026-08-03 report, a KSTP request to DHS to substantiate or break down that figure was still pending.
normalized_claim: AG-reported ~$61M civil judgments component of the $90M headline figure; unverified against DHS data as of 2026-08-03.
qualifiers: Unverified: sourced only to the AG's office's own statement to a reporter, not to a DHS-confirmed ledger.

Arithmetic note: $32M restitution + $61M civil judgments = $93M, not the $90M headline figure the AG's office otherwise cites; this ~$3M discrepancy is unexplained in the source and is preserved here rather than silently rounded away.
editorial_notes: Known gap: chase the DHS breakdown KSTP requested. If DHS responds publicly, capture as a new source and either resolve or formalize this discrepancy as a contradiction.
